#Question 0: Load Library
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

#Question 1 Load Dataset
```{r}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

#1.1 Names of Dataset/Values of Important Variables
```{r}
names(penguins)
janitor::clean_names(penguins)
```
#columns and rows of dataset
```{r}
nrow(penguins)
ncol(penguins)
```
#The mean flipper length included in the skim function AND important values in the dataset
```{r}
skimr::skim(penguins)
```

#The data set names are species, island, bill_length_mm, bill_depth_mm, flipper_length_mm, body_mass_g, sex, year. Species, island, and sex are categorical variables and bill length, bill depth, flipper length, body mass, and year continous variables. There are 344 rows in the dataset and 8 columns. The mean flipper length is 200.92 millimeters.
